name: PezConfiable
comment: PezConfiable turns scattered information into useful decisions for artisanal fishers. The product is a system that supports the fisherman before, during, and after every fishing trip, turning his information into visibility and new opportunities—bringing together sea conditions, prices, regulations, traceability, and commercial connection. Taxonomy CT-IC-003 Supply Chain Traceability; deck Drive id 1_nhww8FixSV9JDOcqkXb0_G8azFaJHkC

name: VIGÍA (ex MUCHIK)
comment: VIGÍA goes beyond conventional monitoring that only measures how much is present: it identifies where water contamination comes from and what information the sample carries, via sample collection, bacteria DNA identification, and data analysis for companies responsible for water treatment and processing. A dashboard turns environmental DNA into actionable information for water treatment, anticipating climate-related risks and protecting operations. Taxonomy CT-WW-001 Water Access & Treatment; deck Drive id 1B986vOBPQTcV3PXARjeYZAh0vtBZ0F5q

name: Wayra Watt
comment: Wayra Watt offers small-scale wind energy solutions for rural tourism operators in Peru, with a wind generator manufactured from recycled materials (aerogenerador fabricado con materiales reciclados). Taxonomy CT-EN-002 Wind Energy; deck Drive id 19DOFLcXv0IJ6lPwTB52aX9sfdKxEzrFV

name: WindLever
comment: WindLever converts wind energy into decisions for your crop: a bladeless wind generator combined with environmental and soil sensors, rechargeable IoT sensors, an integrated platform, and AI agents to automate agricultural decisions and deliver data and monitoring for agroexporters. Taxonomy CT-IC-005 Precision Ag & Smart Grid; deck Drive id 1oifk2DDcbGC4SzpdEj5nw_a9S7mFcjMk

name: YakuSmart
comment: YakuSmart is an intelligence layer for irrigation on agroexport farms: it sells ready-to-execute irrigation decisions—when, how much, and why to water each lot—with the aim of more and better fruit using less water. Taxonomy CT-WW-004 Water Efficiency & Circular Use; deck Drive id 157Lb9SrtO2AhcvIby3-wCKjuq20ZVyoc
